Architect.description: Maintains the project spec and validates work against it.

preferSimplicityLevel.description: Higher values prioritize simple, maintainable solutions.

preferHomebakedCodeLevel.description: Higher values favor bespoke implementations over third-party libraries.

Developer.description: Implements features to meet the specification and commits code.

preferHomebakedCodeLevel.description: Higher values favor custom code instead of external libraries.

TestEngineer.description: Develops tests aiming for comprehensive coverage and recommends testability improvements.

Critic.description: Identifies risks, maintainability concerns, and potential flaws.

NoteTaker.description: Summarizes meetings and prepares reports for the Arbiter.

Arbiter.description: Reviews opinions and calls for next actions or resolutions.
